epithet: Keeper of both sets of weights
bio: The weighing hall's clerk; keeps one set of weights for the days the bell agrees and one for the days it does not.
context_line: Odile keeps two sets of weights and checks the bell before choosing which to set on the scale.
dialogue_hostile: The weights are not for handling.
dialogue_warm: Bell rang true this morning. These are the honest ones; I think.
